instruction: The rows in this feed come from two writers. A run has an `agent` string field; the other writer's rows do not. `summarise` must describe only the runs, and must not count a foreign row as a failed run.
provenance: hexa's own run feed, 2026-09-15: hook events counted as failed runs, reporting 8% pass over 5 runs that had all passed. ADR-2609151100.
